text:
Samir G: Postmortem follow-up for the kv-eviction incident. We promised remediation + tests: nightly regression, incident-derived promptset, short CI cold-cache load, and a 20-min chaos micro-drill. Assigning owners here so we can close the loop.
Lena B: I can own the nightly regression harness. Plan: run 6m cold-cache workload with 40k keys and check eviction_rate + ttl drift. Target PR by Friday EOD.
Chris V: I'll take the promptset curation. Converting incident logs -> 10 canonical prompts + 5 edge cases (including truncation hallucination). Will add expected outputs + scoring notes. ETA next Monday.
Samir G: Who takes the CI job? Need a small job that runs on merges to staging-routing and fails fast if eviction spikes. Also include env tagging.
Lena B: I'll pair with QA to add a gate to the nightly job and a short CI smoke. Nightly gate: eviction_rate < 0.025 and p95 latency < baseline*1.25. If gate fails, create ticket and @oncall.
test-bot: Note: include metrics namespace "kv.cache" and tag run with staging-inference.
Chris V: For promptset scoring, proposal: threshold on exact-match for critical prompts and BLEU >= 0.7 for tolerant cases. Document in prompts/kv-incident.md.
Samir G: I'll own the chaos micro-drill scheduling and playbook. Proposed drill flow (20min): 1) simulate node OOM in region-A, 2) validate routing fallback triggers, 3) confirm degraded-quality alarms and rollback path, 4) restore node. Need oncall and 1 SW engineer.
ops-bot: Drill scheduled: "kv-eviction micro-drill" on 2026-04-09 14:00 UTC. Participants: Samir G, Lena B, Chris V, oncall.
Lena B: CI job snippet I will add to infra/tests:```yaml
jobs:
  kv_cold_smoke:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: ./tests/run_kv_cold.sh --keys 40000 --duration 360
      - run: ./tests/check_metrics.sh --metric kv.cache.eviction_rate --threshold 0.025
```
Chris V: Prompt examples will include the one that caused truncation and the one with hallucinated entity; I'll add expected JSON outputs and a small scoring script.
Samir G: Action slate from thread:
- Lena: nightly regression + CI smoke + gate (PR Fri EOD)
- Chris: promptset + scoring + doc (PR Mon)
- Samir: schedule micro-drill + playbook and oncall invite (done)
- Ops: confirm staging rollout has automatic fallback enabled and routing policy throttles new load during spikes
Please paste PR links here when opened. If any owner needs extra time, ping here. :handshake:
